### Assoc. Prof. Başak Taraktaş
::: {.person-role}
Department of Political Science and International Relations
:::

Başak Taraktaş works on collective action and opinion dynamics, mostly in the context
of regimes and contentious politics, combining computational methods with historical
and comparative analysis. She received her PhD from the University of Pennsylvania and
was previously a postdoctoral fellow at Northwestern's Buffett Institute for Global
Affairs.

[Personal site](https://basaktaraktas.com)
:::
